goal: Use ordinary ChatGPT chat with GitHub as an execution intermediary, without requiring Work or Codex, and produce auditable task evidence and downloadable artifacts.

completionMethods.name: goal_contract_proof
completionMethods.description: The requested goal is machine-readable, bounded, unambiguous, and maps to the ordinary-chat target.

completionMethods.name: route_reachability_proof
completionMethods.description: The GitHub relay is actually executing inside an Actions run and does not depend on an online local device.

completionMethods.name: dynamic_execution_proof
completionMethods.description: Repository execution paths and MCP integration execute successfully instead of only passing static checks.

completionMethods.name: recovery_adversarial_proof
completionMethods.description: Injected failures, stale state, transport interruption, and unsafe request shapes fail closed without false completion.

completionMethods.name: artifact_delivery_proof
completionMethods.description: The final output bundle, hashes, run metadata, and proof reports are reproducibly produced and verified.
